description: The Claim Protocol pre-flight answer for one issue: who holds it, until when, who is queued, which PRs compete, which gates bite, and whether the repo honors the protocol at all. Returns the SPEC 5.1 status payload with competing PRs and gates merged from the check machinery. The verdict vocabulary matches check_issue (GO / RISKY / TAKEN / GATED / STALE); a null verdict means no protocol claims and the check_issue verdict stands.

issue_url.description: Full GitHub issue URL, e.g. https://github.com/owner/repo/issues/123

name: claim_status
